comparison.objective: Set mouse snap traps at droppings, square to a wall with trigger ends at the wall.
comparison.physical_skill: Safely set spring traps and orient them relative to environmental cues, not drive a break-off mandrel with controlled impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Traps must be set at droppings, perpendicular to the wall, trigger end toward it; distance, angle, armed-state, and safety thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although force and hazard handling may be involved, the tested outcome is trap arming and spatial orientation, not fracture plus fragment containment.
